method: Each pending directive cross-referenced against the PROP corpus (monitor/tinker/proposals/PROP-*.json) via three linkage paths: directive_id, source_directive, supersedes_directives fields, plus body-text grep and CLAUDE.md/host-memory OBE confirmations. Category assigned by whether a TERMINAL fulfilling PROP (status in implemented/integrated/applied/self-applied/completed) exists. Deterministic: same corpus -> same categorization.

category_legend.A: FULFILLED — a fulfilling PROP exists (terminal, or a propose-only deliverable already 'proposed'); linkage is missing or the opt-in flag is absent. Backfill action drains it mechanically under PROP-108 enforce mode next tinker run.
category_legend.B: GENUINELY PENDING — the fulfilling PROP is non-terminal (phase-N-shipped / pending / approved / design-pending) or no PROP exists. Leave alone; drains when the PROP reaches terminal.
category_legend.C: SUPERSEDED / OBE — the specific ask was overtaken by a later PROP that took a different approach, or is no longer relevant. Propose status='superseded'.
category_legend.D: UNCLEAR — evidence ambiguous; operator judgment needed.

enforce_mode_note: PROP-108 directive-auto-close is in ENFORCE mode (monitor/decisions/directive-auto-close-enforce.flag present, verified this run). Therefore any Category-A directive whose fulfilling PROP is TERMINAL will auto-close on the NEXT tinker run once the directive_id/source_directive back-ref is added to that PROP file. Category-A propose-only cases need the auto_close_when_deliverable_proposed flag added to the DIRECTIVE itself (PROP-120 handles the propose-only terminal gap).
constraint_compliance: Propose-only. Zero directive/PROP files were modified by this run (no auto-flips applied). All actions below are for operator batch-application.
